name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons)
description: Provides free or subsidised assistive devices such as wheelchairs, motorized tricycles, braille kits, and hearing aids.
eligibility: Indian citizen with 40% or more disability and monthly family income under Rs 20,000.
benefits: Free or subsidised aids, motorized tricycles, braille kits, and hearing aids.

name: Aasara Pension for Persons with Disabilities
description: Monthly social security pension transferred directly to bank accounts of persons with disabilities in Telangana.
eligibility: Telangana resident with SADAREM certificate showing 40% or more disability.
benefits: Monthly financial aid of Rs 4,016 directly transferred to bank account.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card
description: Single national identity card for persons with disabilities to access welfare schemes, travel concessions, and healthcare.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a verified benchmark disability.
benefits: National unified digital card for availing travel concessions, state welfare, and healthcare.

name: National Fellowship for Persons with Disabilities (NFPwD)
description: Fellowship grant supporting students with benchmark disabilities pursuing M.Phil. and Ph.D. degrees.
eligibility: Students with 40% or more disability pursuing regular M.Phil. or Ph.D. in Indian universities.
benefits: Monthly stipend of Rs 31,000 to Rs 35,000 plus contingency allowance for up to 5 years.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: Central scholarship covering tuition, maintenance allowance, and reader/escort charges for higher secondary and college students.
eligibility: Indian students with 40%+ disability in Class 11 through postgraduate courses with annual family income under Rs 2.5 lakh.
benefits: Maintenance allowance, book grant, and disability-specific assistive allowances.
name_hi: दिव्यांग छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
name_ta: மாற்றுத்திறனாளி மாணவர்களுக்கான மெட்ரிக் பிந்தைய கல்வி உதவித்தொகை

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Central monthly pension for adults with severe or multiple disabilities belonging to Below Poverty Line households.
eligibility: Adults aged 18-79 with 80%+ disability or multiple disabilities from BPL households.
benefits: Monthly pension support credited directly to the beneficiary's bank or post office account.
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांग पेंशन योजना
name_te: ఇందిరా గాంధీ జాతీయ దివ్యాంగుల పెన్షన్ పథకం
name_ta: இந்திரா காந்தி தேசிய மாற்றுத்திறனாளிகள் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்

name: TGSRTC Free & Concessional Bus Pass for PwDs
description: Telangana State Road Transport Corporation pass offering free city travel and discounted intercity fares.
eligibility: Telangana residents with a valid SADAREM or UDID disability certificate (40%+).
benefits: Free travel on Palle Velugu and City Ordinary buses; 50% concession on Express/Deluxe services.
name_ta: TGSRTC மாற்றுத்திறனாளிகள் இலவச பேருந்து பயண அட்டை

name: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme
description: Affordable health insurance for persons with autism, cerebral palsy, intellectual disability, and multiple disabilities.
eligibility: Persons with disabilities covered under the National Trust Act with a valid disability certificate.
benefits: Health coverage up to Rs 1,00,000 per year including OPD, therapy, and hospitalization.

name: Sugamya Pustakalaya (Accessible Online Library)
description: National online library offering books and educational content in DAISY audio, Braille-ready, and large-print formats.
eligibility: Persons with visual impairment, print disabilities, or low vision.
benefits: Free access to hundreds of thousands of accessible books across Indian languages.

name: Cochlear Implant Assistance under ADIP
description: Financial and surgical support for cochlear implants and post-operative speech therapy for children with severe hearing loss.
eligibility: Children under 5 years with bilateral severe-to-profound sensorineural hearing loss and family income under Rs 20,000/month.
benefits: Up to Rs 6,00,000 per child covering implant device, surgery, and mapping/rehabilitation.
